description: Creates a shim from a name, the question it answers, and its answers. Add examples afterwards with workbench_shim_add_examples — three or more per answer and it builds on its own. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

inputsComeFrom.description: One line on where the inputs come from, in the user's words.

question.description: The question, e.g. "Which team should read this message?"

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_shim_create
title: Create a shim
